text.content:
Sect: Independent

The Followers of Set are a secretive clan devoted to a slumbering, serpentine god, working to corrupt mortal and Kindred society alike in pursuit of their religion's obscure goals. They trade in vice, temptation, and forbidden knowledge, often operating from dens of debauchery that double as places of worship.

Disciplines: Obfuscate, Presence, Serpentis

Advantage: Every Setite gains one bonus Streetwise Ability Trait and a level of Political, Street or Underworld Influence.

Disadvantage: Setites are sensitive to light. Sunlight always inflicts an extra health level of damage, and bright artificial light (spotlights, flares, floodlights) causes a one-Trait penalty on all challenges.

Organization: Loosely organized around temples and cults dedicated to their sleeping god, with influence networks built on blackmail, addiction, and the exploitation of others' weaknesses.
